rig.name: Bruce Springsteen - Born To Run - Valeton GP-180

blocks.purpose: Clean up hum and background noise.
Provide the classic Tube Screamer-style mid-hump and tight rhythm drive.
Add the required slight fuzz texture and grit without excessive high gain.
blocks.gap: The RAT-style is used to complement the Green OD's mid focus, adding controlled dirt/fuzz.

blocks.purpose: Simulate the Plexi/Marshall crunch and bright arena rock tone.
Provide the classic British rock cabinet sound.
Boost the mid-range bite and ensure a bright, open sound.
Add subtle movement and width to the rhythm parts.
blocks.gap: The Chorus is used sparingly to add texture without heavy modulation, as requested.

blocks.purpose: Add a sense of large arena space without muddying the crunch.
Add subtle rhythmic echo for depth.
blocks.gap: Kept minimal to avoid long delay, as requested.

improvements.summary: Upgrade IR for better cabinet realism and open sound.

proposals.reason: Enhance the bright, open arena rock tone.
